outlook.title: Central Portion and West Portion of the East Pacific
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure is forecast to form several hundred miles south of the southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula this weekend or early next week. Some gradual development is possible thereafter, and a tropical depression could form early next week while the system moves generally west-northwestward.

outlook.title: Well South-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure is forecast to form several hundred miles south-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands. Some gradual development is possible late this week into this weekend as this system moves slowly north-northwestward.
